// supabase/functions/email-bounces/index.test.ts — the signature check, the one thing
// standing between the public internet and the service role. Run with `deno test`.
import { assertEquals } from 'jsr:@std/assert@1'

const SECRET = 'test-secret'
const encoder = new TextEncoder()

async function sign(timestamp: string, body: string): Promise<string> {
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    'raw',
    encoder.encode(SECRET),
    { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' },
    false,
    ['sign'],
  )
  const mac = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, encoder.encode(`${timestamp}.${body}`)))
  return Array.from(mac, (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')
}

Deno.env.set('SUPABASE_URL', 'http://127.0.0.1:54321')
Deno.env.set('SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY', 'sb_secret_test')
Deno.env.set('EMAIL_BOUNCE_WEBHOOK_SECRET', SECRET)

let handler: (req: Request) => Promise<Response> = () => Promise.reject(new Error('not served'))
Deno.serve = ((h: (req: Request) => Promise<Response>) => {
  handler = h
}) as unknown as typeof Deno.serve
await import('./index.ts')

const post = (headers: Record<string, string>, body: string) =>
  handler(new Request('http://localhost/email-bounces', { method: 'POST', headers, body }))

Deno.test('a tampered body is refused', async () => {
  const ts = String(Date.now())
  const signature = await sign(ts, '{"email":"a@example.test"}')
  const res = await post({ 'x-bounce-timestamp': ts, 'x-bounce-signature': signature }, '{"email":"b@example.test"}')
  assertEquals(res.status, 401)
})

Deno.test('a stale timestamp is refused', async () => {
  const ts = String(Date.now() - 10 * 60 * 1000)
  const body = '{"email":"a@example.test"}'
  const res = await post({ 'x-bounce-timestamp': ts, 'x-bounce-signature': await sign(ts, body) }, body)
  assertEquals(res.status, 401)
})

Deno.test('a request with no signature is refused', async () => {
  const res = await post({ 'x-bounce-timestamp': String(Date.now()) }, '{"email":"a@example.test"}')
  assertEquals(res.status, 401)
})
